'''Mayam Colona''' is a [[Tairen]] [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[White Ajah]]<ref>The Wheel of Time Companion</ref>. She has no Warder.

== Appearance and Personality ==
Mayam is slim, 5'6 tall, with dark skin, black eyes and black hair. She still lacks the ageless look of an Aes Sedai.

She could eat as much as she liked without gaining a pound.

==Strength and Abilities==
Mayam has a strength in the [[One Power]] of {{opsl|27}}, [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|average]] for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to [[Traveling|Travel]] unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

== History ==
Mayam was born in [[Tear]] in {{ne|960}} and went to the [[White Tower]] in [[977 NE]]. After spending twelve years as a [[novice]] and eight years as [[Accepted]], she was raised to the shawl in [[997 NE]].

== Activities ==
She remains loyal to the White Tower during the split.

She was part of the White Tower secret expedition who were to kidnap [[Rand al'Thor]] in [[Cairhien]]. She arrived at Lady [[Arilyn Dhulaine]]'s manor two days after the official embassy arrived.

Because she has not yet the typical ageless look of an Aes Sedai, Mayam was among the sisters who helped to carry the chest during the actual kidnapping.

She was taken prisoner during the Battle of [[Dumai's Wells]] by the [[Asha'man]]<ref>The Wheel of Time Companion</ref>{{ref/book|6|55}}.

Mayam was one of the captured Aes Sedai{{ref/book|7|1}} to be interrogated by [[Verin Mathwin]] in order to discover the White Tower's intentions towards [[Rand al'Thor]]{{ref/book|8|p}}. In reality Verin used her mild [[Compulsion]] to implant in their minds some instructions about Rand.

Later it is reported by [[Sorilea]] that all the Aes Sedai prisoners have sworn fealty to Rand{{ref/book|9|13}}.

As with many Aes Sedai sworn to Rand, Mayam probably fought the [[Last Battle]] on the slopes of [[Thakan'dar]]{{ref/book|14|34}}. She is not mentioned during the last book.
